title.en: A parody toy where AI quota resets always work
title.zh: AI 額度永遠能重置的惡搞小玩具

description.en: A one-file browser toy: four mock AI usage panels burn quota in real time, and pressing reset frees a chained golden dragon. Play it on GitHub Pages; an optional Odoo module adds shared counts.
description.zh: 單一 HTML 檔的瀏覽器小玩具：四個仿造的 AI 用量面板即時燒額度，按下重置就能放出被鎖鏈綁住的黃金龍。可以直接在 GitHub Pages 上玩，選配的 Odoo 模組能讓訪客共用次數。

eyebrow.en: Parody browser toy · One HTML file
eyebrow.zh: 惡搞瀏覽器小玩具 · 單一 HTML 檔

lede.en: Four mock usage panels (Codex, Claude, Gemini, Grok) burn quota while you watch. Press reset and the bars refill, the chains snap, and a golden dragon breaks free. A joke for people who live inside AI quota limits.
lede.zh: 四個仿造的用量面板（Codex、Claude、Gemini、Grok）就在你眼前燒額度。按下重置，額度回滿、鎖鏈斷開，黃金龍重獲自由。獻給活在 AI 額度上限裡的人。

alt.en: Reset Therapy in a desktop browser, English interface: four chained golden dragons with reset buttons above mock usage panels for Claude, Codex, Gemini, and Grok, all marked burning
alt.zh: Reset Therapy 桌面版英文介面：四條被鎖鏈綁住的黃金龍和各自的重置鈕，下方是 Claude、Codex、Gemini、Grok 的仿造用量面板，狀態都是燃燒中

caption.en: Before any reset: all four providers are burning.
caption.zh: 還沒重置：四家都在燃燒中。

intro.en: It all runs in the browser. Nothing reads a real account, and nothing resets a real quota.
intro.zh: 全部在瀏覽器裡執行，不讀任何真實帳號，也不會重置任何真實額度。

body.en: Mock usage pages modeled on the ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok settings screens. Until you reset a provider, its numbers creep up every 0.9 seconds and stop just short of the limit.
body.zh: 仿照 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Grok 設定畫面做的用量頁。還沒重置的那幾家，數字每 0.9 秒往上爬一點，一路爬到快滿才停。

body.en: Each provider has its own reset button (clicking the dragon works too), or press Reset all four. The chains break with a clank and confetti, the bars reset, and the freed dragon gets a comic bubble. Once all four are free, Burned out again... starts it over.
body.zh: 每家都有自己的重置鈕（直接點龍也可以），或是按全部重置吧一次救四家。鎖鏈噹啷斷開、彩帶噴出、用量歸零，重獲自由的龍會冒出漫畫對話框。四家都救回來之後，按哭啊, 又全部燒光了就一切重來。

title.en: A leaderboard that is mostly theatre
title.zh: 大半是演出來的排行榜

body.en: After your first reset, a Weekly Therapy Leaderboard appears. Its numbers are a fake baseline computed from the date plus real presses: from the optional stats API when the page can reach it, otherwise from this browser's localStorage.
body.zh: 第一次重置之後，會出現本週療癒排行榜。上面的數字是依日期算出來的假基準值，加上真實的重置次數：連得到選配的統計 API 就用全站累計，連不到就用這個瀏覽器 localStorage 裡的次數。

title.en: The Chinese version, on a phone.

intro.en: Captured at phone width with ?lang=zh. The layout drops to one column and the interface text switches to Traditional Chinese (the dragons' comic bubbles stay in English).
intro.zh: 用手機寬度加上 ?lang=zh 擷取：版面收成單欄，介面文字換成繁體中文（龍的漫畫對話框維持英文）。

alt.en: Chinese interface on a phone: Claude's dragon in chains next to its reset button, session usage at 76 percent, status burning
alt.zh: 手機上的中文介面：Claude 的龍被鎖鏈綁住，旁邊是重置鈕，目前工作階段已使用 76%，狀態燃燒中

caption.zh: 燃燒中：數字還在往上爬。

alt.en: After resetting Claude: the dragon is free with a comic bubble, usage back to 0 percent, and the status line reads 1 of 4 restored
alt.zh: 重置 Claude 之後：龍掙脫鎖鏈並冒出漫畫對話框，用量回到 0%，狀態列顯示已復活 1/4 家

caption.en: One reset: the chains are gone and usage is back to 0%.
caption.zh: 重置一家：鎖鏈不見了，用量回到 0%。

alt.en: After Reset all four: the status line reads quotas full and world peace, with a second button for burning out again
alt.zh: 全部重置之後：狀態列顯示額度全滿、世界和平，旁邊多了一顆再燒光一次的按鈕

caption.en: All four: world peace, plus a button to burn out again.
caption.zh: 四家全滿：世界和平，外加一顆再燒光一次的按鈕。

title.zh: 線上直接玩，自己也能架。

intro.en: The toy is index.html and nothing else. The stats API and the art scripts are optional.
intro.zh: 玩具本體就只有 index.html，統計 API 和美術腳本都是選配。

title.en: Play online, or open it locally

body.en: Play at ./play/ (Chinese: ./play/?lang=zh). For your own copy, clone the repository and open index.html, or serve the folder and open http://localhost:8000/.
body.zh: 線上版在 ./play/?lang=zh。想自己跑一份，就把 這個 repo clone 下來，直接用瀏覽器打開 index.html，或用下面的指令架起來，再打開 http://localhost:8000/。

body.en: Without a backend the page uses local counts. To share counts across visitors, serve these two endpoints on the same origin. server/reset_therapy_stats/ is an Odoo 19 module that does this with one SQLite file, one row per provider per week.
body.zh: 沒有後端時，頁面用的是本機次數。想讓所有訪客看到同一份數字，就在同一個網域提供下面兩個端點。server/reset_therapy_stats/ 是 Odoo 19 模組版的實作，次數存在一個 SQLite 檔，每家每週一列。

body.en: gen_dragons.py asks gpt-image-2 for four golden dragon busts. drg_post.py (Pillow) crops them to 600x750 WebP and inlines them, but only into an index.html that still has __DRG_*__ placeholders; the shipped file has the art baked in.
body.zh: gen_dragons.py 呼叫 gpt-image-2 生成四張黃金龍半身像，drg_post.py（需要 Pillow）再把圖裁成 600x750 的 WebP 內嵌進去。不過它只能寫進還留著 __DRG_*__ 預留標記的 index.html，repo 裡的版本已經把圖內嵌好了。

steps.code:
cd art
export OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...
python3 gen_dragons.py
python3 drg_post.py

intro.en: Version 8, first published in July 2026. The stats module has 32 plain-Python tests that run in CI, and there are no releases: it is a finished joke, not a product.
intro.zh: 第 8 版，2026 年 7 月首次發佈。統計模組有 32 個純 Python 測試，會在 CI 上執行；沒有 release：這是一個完成的玩笑，不是產品。

works.en: Runs from disk or any static host, including this GitHub Pages site
works.zh: 直接開檔或放在任何靜態主機都能跑，包括這個 GitHub Pages 網站

works.en: Per-provider and reset-all buttons, clickable dragons, comic bubbles, confetti, and Web Audio sound effects
works.zh: 單家重置、全部重置、可以點的龍、漫畫對話框、彩帶與 Web Audio 音效

works.en: English and Traditional Chinese, via ?lang=zh or the switcher in the corner
works.zh: 英文與繁體中文，用 ?lang=zh 或右上角的按鈕切換

works.en: With prefers-reduced-motion set, animations, confetti, and the screen flash are turned off
works.zh: 系統開啟「減少動態效果」時，動畫、彩帶和閃屏都會關掉

works.en: Optional Odoo 19 module for shared weekly and all-time counts
works.zh: 選配的 Odoo 19 模組，提供全站共用的每週與累計次數

limits.en: GitHub Pages has no stats API, so the leaderboard here shows the baseline plus your own presses. The copy on ted-h.com runs the stats module and counts presses from every visitor
limits.zh: GitHub Pages 上沒有統計 API，所以這裡的排行榜只有基準值加上你自己的次數。ted-h.com 上的版本掛著統計模組，會累計所有訪客的次數

limits.en: Leaderboard numbers are mostly a fake baseline, and the quota panels are animation, not data
limits.zh: 排行榜的數字大部分是假的基準值，額度面板也只是動畫，不是真實資料

limits.en: The stats API is public, with no authentication. Each address can press at most 30 times a minute, which slows scripted pressing but cannot stop someone with many addresses
limits.zh: 統計 API 是公開的，沒有驗證。每個來源位址每分鐘最多 30 次，可以減緩用腳本狂按，但擋不住手上有很多位址的人

limits.en: Redrawing the dragons needs an OpenAI API key and a placeholder template the repo does not include
limits.zh: 重畫龍需要 OpenAI API 金鑰，還要自備 repo 沒附的預留標記範本

limits.en: A parody: the panels imitate real settings pages for the joke, and the project is not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or xAI
limits.zh: 這是惡搞作品：面板模仿真實設定頁只是為了好笑，本專案與 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、xAI 都沒有關係

intro.en: The panels are animation. A reset here refills them, and the relapse button starts the climb again.
intro.zh: 面板上的數字是動畫。在這裡按下重置會把額度補滿，再燒一次的按鈕會讓數字重新往上爬。

note.en: Every 0.9 seconds, a provider that is not reset moves toward its cap, then stops just short.
note.zh: 還沒重置的那一家，數字每 0.9 秒往上爬，快到上限就停。

note.en: The button or the dragon refills that panel, snaps the chains, and plays the clank.
note.zh: 按按鈕或點龍，面板回滿、鎖鏈斷開，並播放斷鏈的聲音。

note.en: When all four are free, that button clears the resets and the numbers start climbing again.
note.zh: 四家都自由之後，這顆按鈕會清掉重置，數字再從燃燒中開始爬。

caption.en: Until you reset a provider, its mock usage numbers climb every 0.9 seconds and stop just short of the cap. Reset, from the button or the dragon, refills that panel and breaks its chains. After all four are free, Burned out again clears them and the climb starts over. None of this reads a real account.
caption.zh: 還沒重置的面板，仿造用量每 0.9 秒往上爬，快到上限就停。按重置鈕或點龍，會把那一家補滿並打斷鎖鏈。四家都自由之後，再燒一次會清掉重置，數字重新往上爬。這些都不會讀取真實帳號。

intro.en: The browser always keeps your own count. A shared total exists only when the same origin serves the stats module.
intro.zh: 瀏覽器一定會記下你自己的次數。只有同一個網域有掛統計模組時，才會有全站共用的總數。

note.en: Each reset adds one to rtCounts in localStorage, on GitHub Pages and everywhere else.
note.zh: 每一次重置都會把 localStorage 裡的 rtCounts 加一，GitHub Pages 上也一樣。

note.en: The page POSTs /reset-therapy/api/heal on its own origin, and ignores the call if it fails.
note.zh: 頁面會對自己的網域 POST /reset-therapy/api/heal，失敗就當作沒這回事。

note.en: If the Odoo module answers, the board uses its Taipei week counts instead of this browser's.
note.zh: 若 Odoo 模組有回應，排行榜就改用它的台北週次數，不再用這台瀏覽器的數字。

caption.en: A reset always increments rtCounts in this browser's localStorage. The page then tries POST /reset-therapy/api/heal on the same origin. GitHub Pages has no such API, so the request fails and the leaderboard stays on the fake baseline plus your own presses. The copy on ted-h.com runs the Odoo module, and a successful answer replaces the local counts with the shared week and all-time totals. The baseline itself is still computed from the date.
caption.zh: 每次重置都會增加這個瀏覽器 localStorage 裡的 rtCounts。頁面接著對同一個網域 POST /reset-therapy/api/heal。GitHub Pages 沒有這個 API，請求失敗，排行榜就維持日期算出來的假基準加上你自己的次數。ted-h.com 上的版本有跑 Odoo 模組，成功的回應會改用全站的本週與累計次數。基準值本身仍是依日期算出來的。

intro.en: This path exists only in the optional stats module. The toy on GitHub Pages never reaches it.
intro.zh: 這條路只存在於選配的統計模組。GitHub Pages 上的玩具走不到這裡。

note.en: The module accepts at most 4 KB of UTF-8 JSON. Anything larger or malformed is a 400.
note.zh: 模組最多接受 4 KB 的 UTF-8 JSON。更大或格式不對就回 400。

note.en: Only claude, codex, gemini, and grok count. Unknown names are dropped and a duplicate counts once.
note.zh: 只計算 claude、codex、gemini、grok。不認識的名稱會丟掉，重複的只算一次。

note.en: Each client may have 30 accepted heals in any 60 seconds. The count is shared by every Odoo worker.
note.zh: 每個客戶端在任意 60 秒內最多 30 次成功的療癒，所有 Odoo worker 共用這個上限。

note.en: Past the limit the answer is 429 with Retry-After, and no weekly counter changes.
note.zh: 超過上限就回 429 並附上 Retry-After，本週的計數不會增加。

caption.en: In server/reset_therapy_stats/core.py, a heal body must be at most 4 KB of UTF-8 JSON whose providers list names claude, codex, gemini, or grok. Unknown names are ignored and duplicates count once, so one request adds at most one per provider. Each client, keyed from CF-Connecting-IP or the forwarding headers and stored as a hash, gets 30 accepted heals in any 60 seconds across Odoo workers. The 31st is a 429 with Retry-After and writes nothing. Accepted heals add one to that provider's Monday-start Taipei week row in SQLite. The public toy does not call this code.
caption.zh: 在 server/reset_therapy_stats/core.py 裡，療癒請求的內容最多 4 KB，而且必須是 UTF-8 JSON，providers 裡要有 claude、codex、gemini 或 grok。不認識的名稱會忽略，重複的只算一次，所以一次請求每一家最多加 1。客戶端依 CF-Connecting-IP 或轉送標頭辨認，位址只存雜湊。任意 60 秒內最多 30 次成功，所有 Odoo worker 一起算。第 31 次回 429 並附上 Retry-After，什麼都不寫。成功的請求會在 SQLite 裡，把該家台北時間週一開始的那一週加 1。GitHub Pages 上的玩具不會呼叫這段程式。
